title: MICODELIRIO
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance is the result of a natural vital delirium, evoking a flourishing ecosystem of organic disobedience.

title: PERFUME OIL SET
body: This customisable set lets you choose three 4 ml perfume oils from the collection to create a personal fragrance experience.

title: SADONASO
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. There is no purpose in life beyond the pleasure of the senses. I have a secret desire that even I don’t know about, as I am constantly discovering a new one. I think that secret represents the true future.

title: FANTOMAS
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance is an elusive hint towards the transgressive act that has been carried out with an ease of refined precision.

title: NUDIFLORUM
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. It is the result of a quest to find a vanishing point in nature, a nude desire in the translucence of our senses.

title: BARAONDA
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance encourages a raw taste sensation. It is the result of a quest to evoke the powerful and mighty whisper of an olfactory stirring, which magically rejoins the whole and the nothing.

title: BLAMAGE
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance is an unwise and unfortunate creation caused by bad judgement and care.

title: PARDON
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance aims to evoke the persuasion of utmost masculine elegance and charm.

title: BLACK AFGANO
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance aims to evoke the best quality of hashish. It is the result of a quest to arouse the effects of temporary bliss.

title: SILVER MUSK
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance aims to evoke superhero magnetism. It is the result of a quest for mercurial liquid love sensation.

title: ABSINTH
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance aims to evoke degrees of hysteria. It is the result of a quest to stimulate irresponsible behaviour.

title: NARCOTIC V.
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance is the result of a quest for the overwhelming addictive intensity of female sexual power.

title: DURO
body: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance aims to enhance all the manifestations of male strength.
